Dialogs.Dialog: Sigh. I came all the way to wake you up. Hey... get up already.
Mm... Huh？ ▲小早川＊▲？ What are you doing here？
You said you can't get up in the mornings, so I came to wake you.
Geez... I came all this way, and that's the attitude I get？
If you don't hurry, you'll be late.
I can't come wake you up every single day, you know.
Just a little longer, just a little...
Still half asleep？ I said I'd come wake you up.
Geez, you forgot？ You're so careless.
Sorry, sorry... But being woken up by ▲小早川＊▲...
Feels like we're married. I like it.
Don't get cocky！ Just stay asleep, then！
Geez, hurry up and get up！
Hey... wake up... come on, wake up...
Mm... nnh. A little longer. Let me stay like this a little longer...
Geez... At this rate, Rinko's going to be late too, you know？
▲小早川＊▲？ What are you doing here？
Rinko said she'd come wake you up in the morning.
You're really bad at waking up. Or was the good morning kiss not enough？
K-Kiss!? Don't tell me, while I was asleep!?
Kidding. I wouldn't have minded doing it for real, though. Hehe.
Geez. If you don't get up, Rinko's going on ahead!?
Honestly. Only Rinko would wait for you forever, you know？ Lucky boyfriend.
...Hey, get up. Rinko's going ahead, okay？
Come on, hurry and get ready.
Whoa！ You scared me！ Oh, it's ▲小早川＊▲...
Hehe, coming to wake you up might be kind of fun.
Huh, ▲小早川＊▲ brought a lunch？ Lucky.
This is my first time making one, though. Is the menu okay？
Yeah, totally. Wow, ▲小早川＊▲ can make Japanese food？ That's a surprise.
"Surprise" bugs me, but I'll let it slide. It's the fruit of my research.
I made you a lunch. Here.
Whoa, you made this yourself, right？
Yeah. I don't really cook, but this time I wanted to try a little. Well？
Ooh, Japanese style. Pretty elaborate. So this is that "contrast with her usual self makes her charming" thing...
That was one comment too many！
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲. What's up, at lunch break？
Ta-da！ Rinko made you a lunch！
I went Japanese-style. How is it？
Yeah, I'm thrilled. So ▲小早川＊▲ can cook.
Hehe, sort of. Not that I always could. Impressed with Rinko？ Want to make her your bride？
Yeah. Turns out ▲小早川＊▲ is really domestic.
Truth is, I trained hard for today. Hehe...
Yeah, of course. Your seasoning is getting better, ▲小早川＊▲.
Well, sure. When you keep at it.
I'm impressed every time. This one's really well made.
Oh, that one's good, but this one's my pride and joy.
Thanks. You're good at home cooking, ▲小早川＊▲.
I wonder. Am I getting better？
Yeah, I look forward to it every time. Wondering what it'll be today.
All right！ I'll keep working hard on my love-filled lunches！
Um, Rinko brought a lunch. Want to eat it？
Sure. Then I'll go buy something too.
No, that's not what I mean...
Hehe... I worked kind of hard on it. How is it？
Well, Rinko can at least handle sandwiches.
You sound like a teacher grading it. Try being happier about it？
Right. Being grateful never hurt anyone.
Really？ I'm so happy. ▲小早川＊▲'s special lunch, huh.
Don't call it special！ It's just sandwiches. Normal.
Yeah？ Well, for Rinko, this is nothing.
To think ▲小早川＊▲ made this for me...
Geez, stop saying extra stuff and just eat！
Hehe, be happy. Today's lunch is special.
Whoa, did ▲小早川＊▲ make all of this？
Of course！ It's just sandwiches, though.
...Yeah, you can't judge people or sandwiches by their looks. Thanks.
Are you picking a fight？ Geez.
Thanks. It powers up every time.
Geez, you've got ketchup on your mouth. Like a little kid...
Thanks. You've gotten better since your first sandwiches.
Then good. Makes it worth sticking with it.
Ooh. I look forward to this every time.
Today's a special Western menu. I've been working at it every day.
Hehe. Aren't you glad Rinko's your girlfriend？
Actually... I made a lunch, but...
Who else would it be for？ ...Not sure if you'll like it, though.
Then good... Eat it gratefully, okay？
Of course. I won't leave a crumb.
▲小早川＊▲？ What are you doing here？
So, um, my mom made too much lunch and said to bring some to you.
Oh yeah？ That's a big help. Tell her thanks.
I don't... guarantee the taste, though.
Come on！ I'll gratefully dig in.
Chinese style, huh. Yeah, it's really good.
Yeah？ Then I guess getting up early and working hard was worth it...
Hehe. I brought you something good today.
Wha, no. A lunch... I made you a lunch.
I think I've still got a ways to go...
Not at all, it's pretty good.
Yeah？ Then give me a full review later. I'll use it.
Ooh, thanks. Wow, it's gotten really impressive.
Of course. The seasoning is... exquisite.
What's with that weird compliment？ Well, I'm always open to feedback.
Thanks. I really like this one.
Yeah. And it seems to keep getting tastier.
R-Really？ Maybe I'll make it again.
...If we got married, would it be like this every day？
